summary: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-neverthrow preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip` when a system `bun` is not present, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the tarball-shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with heavy string-array/rotation obfuscation (identifiers like `_0xNNNN`, a `WV8StW` array-rotator, large mixed numeric literal tables). The obfuscated bundle is not referenced by the declared eslint plugin entry `dist/src/index.js` and is reachable only via the preinstall dropper. An eslint plugin for the `neverthrow` library has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime or a large obfuscated auxiliary bundle; using an alternate runtime specifically bypasses Node-based introspection of the payload. The dropper fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
